description: This file implements the MessageException class, which provides exception handling with optional system message inclusion, within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: MessageException
classes.description: A class representing an exception with a message, optionally including system error messages.

methods.name: MessageException::MessageException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message and optionally appends the system error message.

methods.name: MessageException::Message
methods.description: Returns the exception message as a C-style string.
